parts.latex: Which of the following could be the graph of $y = -2x + 2$?

solutions.latex:
For $y=-2x+2$ the gradient is $-2$, so the line slopes downwards from left to right.

The $y$-intercept is found by putting $x=0$:
$$y=2$$
The $x$-intercept is found by putting $y=0$:
$$\begin{aligned} 0&=-2x+2\\ x&=1 \end{aligned}$$
So the line has negative gradient, a positive $y$-intercept and a positive $x$-intercept.

Only option A has all three features: B has a negative $y$-intercept and C and D have positive gradient.

So the answer is option A.

parts.latex:
Suppose $y = -1 - 2x$.

When the value of $x$ increases by 5, the value of $y$ decreases by

solutions.latex:
The gradient of $y=-1-2x$ is $-2$, so $y$ changes by $-2$ for each increase of $1$ in $x$.

When $x$ increases by $5$:
$$\begin{aligned} \Delta y &= -2\times 5 \\ &= -10 \end{aligned}$$
So $y$ decreases by $10$.

$$\therefore\ y \text{ decreases by } 10$$

parts.latex:
Chloe has saved to buy a new phone that costs \$1018.

Her parents gave her \$100 and she saved \$34 per week until she had enough money to buy the phone.

The equation $y = mx + c$ models the amount of money that Chloe has.

Which row shows the correct values for $m, x$ and $c$?

solutions.latex:
In $y = mx + c$, $c$ is the starting amount and $m$ is the amount added each week, so $x$ is the number of weeks.

The starting amount is $c = 100$ and the weekly saving is $m = 34$.

For the phone, $y = 1018$, so
$$\begin{aligned} 1018 &= 34x + 100 \\ 34x &= 918 \\ x &= 27 \end{aligned}$$
So $m = 34$, $x = 27$ and $c = 100$, which is option D.
